source.author: verg
source.text: Postquam introgressi et coram data copia fandi, maxumus Ilioneus placido sic pectore coepit:
source.text_original: Postquam introgressi et coram data copia fandi, / maxumus Ilioneus placido sic pectore coepit: /
source.text_english: When they had entered and were given the opportunity to speak face to face, the eldest, Ilioneus, began thus with calm heart:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Omnis avet quae iam bellis spectataque fama turba ducum, primae seu quos in flore iuventae temptamenta tenent necdum data copia rerum:
reuse.text_original: Omnis avet quae iam bellis spectataque fama / turba ducum, primae seu quos in flore iuventae / temptamenta tenent necdum data copia rerum: /
reuse.text_english: All the whole crowd of leaders, already famed and tested in wars, whether those whom the first bloom of youth still holds in their first attempts and to whom no full opportunity has yet been given, longs for it.
